description: Backstop deny-list for Azure DevOps credentials (CFS package feeds in tabs, ADR 20261105-cfs-package-feeds-in-tabs). A tab's CFS credential is bound to GET on the exact feed read paths; this denies, by provider name or host, any credentialed call that could mint or manage a credential (the REST API under _apis, including PATs and token sessions) or write to a feed (publish, unlist, delete). Paths are matched case-insensitively against the canonical path with any trailing slash removed.

source.note: Azure DevOps REST API reference. Feed URLs and the package-feed layout are from github/cfs-at-github docs/package-feeds.md at 8dcb42bcb7d27eb7eeb931b8ca1c2e3c64bb15a0 (private; cited by path).

deny.reason: Azure DevOps REST API root (organisation-less hosts such as vssps.dev.azure.com): tokens, PATs, identities https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/rest/api/azure/devops/tokens/pats
Organisation-level REST API: PAT lifecycle (_apis/tokens/pats), feed management (_apis/packaging/feeds) https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/rest/api/azure/devops/artifacts/feed-management
Project-level REST API, including project-scoped feed management
Writes to an organisation-scoped feed: npm publish is a PUT on the registry path, PyPI upload a POST, unpublish a DELETE https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/devops/artifacts/npm/publish
Writes to a project-scoped feed such as /github-cfs/GitHubCFS/_packaging/... (see above)
